asks.original: Bangla translation er por o onek english sentence dekhachhe
asks.line_en: Many English sentences still show in Bengali mode.
asks.line_bn: বাংলা করার পরেও অনেক ইংরেজি বাক্য দেখাচ্ছে।
asks.plan: Translate the model-written and code-written sentences, or show the stored Bengali line.

asks.original: Feedback likhle seta queue te dekhachhe na
asks.line_en: Posted feedback does not show in the queue.
asks.line_bn: ফিডব্যাক লিখলে সেটা কিউতে দেখাচ্ছে না।
asks.plan: Show a posted message at once as Received.

asks.original: UI ta bhalo na ekhane, track korar jonno
asks.line_en: The screen is poor for tracking feedback.
asks.line_bn: ট্র্যাক করার জন্য এখানকার স্ক্রিনটা ভালো না।
asks.plan: Give each ask its own row with a status.

asks.original: kono list update hole amake yellow notification e dekhabe
asks.line_en: Show a yellow mark when a list changes.
asks.line_bn: কোনো তালিকা বদলালে হলুদ চিহ্নে দেখাবে।
asks.plan: Add a yellow dot per changed list.

asks.original: prediction change hole amake yellow notification e dekhabe
asks.line_en: Show a yellow mark when a prediction changes.
asks.plan: Mark the stock yellow and show the old and new call.

asks.line_en: The charts have no full history.
asks.plan: Load the full price history into the chart.

asks.line_en: The chart needs zoom in and zoom out.
asks.line_bn: চার্টে জুম ইন আর জুম আউট দরকার।

asks.original: puro kite er moton o nei
asks.line_en: The chart should look like Kite's.
asks.plan: Candles, time ranges, volume and a crosshair like Kite's.

asks.original: sob stock er lifetime chart laagbe
asks.line_en: Every stock needs a chart since it was listed.
asks.plan: Chart every stock from its listing date.

asks.original: onek bugs aache buttons e, ogulo think koro
asks.line_en: Many buttons have bugs; find them yourselves.
asks.line_bn: বোতামগুলোতে অনেক ভুল আছে, নিজেরা খুঁজে ঠিক করো।
asks.plan: Walk every button and fix what breaks.

asks.original: full view te chart boro dekhao
asks.line_en: Show the chart bigger in full view.

asks.original: NSE er sathe BSE and SME stock o thakbe
asks.line_en: Include BSE and SME stocks along with NSE.
asks.line_bn: এনএসইর সাথে বিএসই আর এসএমই স্টকও থাকবে।
asks.plan: Search every NSE, BSE and SME stock.

asks.original: ANAWIL stock ta ami khuje pelam na
asks.line_en: He could not find ANAWIL in search.
asks.plan: Add ANAWIL to the search list and forgive misspellings.

asks.original: market news sobsomoy live ar update thakte hobe
asks.line_en: Market news must always be live.
asks.line_bn: বাজারের খবর সবসময় লাইভ থাকতে হবে।

asks.original: saathe saathe special stocks er list o
asks.line_en: Also a list of stocks picked because of the news.
asks.line_bn: সাথে সাথে বিশেষ স্টকের তালিকাও চাই।
asks.plan: Keep a news-picked stock list updated with the news.
